2003-04.summary: Retooled around Garnett’s MVP peak by adding veteran guards and wings, most notably Sam Cassell and Latrell Sprewell, for a West finals push.

2007-08.summary: Kevin Garnett traded to Boston in a blockbuster rebuild trade—franchise identity shifts toward youth and assets.
Draft class (Brewer, Richard) landed in the same window as the megadeal—use the season hub for roster facts and the static explorer for a cited walkthrough.

2014-15.summary: Selected Zach LaVine and traded for Andrew Wiggins as part of the Love deal return package.

2017-18.summary: Jimmy Butler acquired to pair with Towns and Wiggins; Wolves break a 14-year playoff drought.
Veteran free-agent additions around the Butler trade changed the rotation’s age, defense, and late-game profile.

2022-23.summary: Deadline reshuffle around the Edwards–Towns core brought in steadier guard play and reset the late-season rotation as the team pursued playoff seeding in a crowded West.
